title: PHP doesn't suck (anymore)
summary: Aaron Francis walks through how PHP has changed from 2012 to 2023, covering traits, array destructuring, generators, typed properties and more. It is a quick chaptered tour of modern PHP features.
why: HN commenters share it to show that modern PHP is much better than its reputation.

quote.text: I was quite surprised to see how far PHP has come since I used it many years ago
